rest-module-personaldashboard.v0-title: Title of the personaldashboard.v0 REST module.
rest-module-personaldashboard.v0-desc: Description of the personaldashboard.v0 REST module, shown in the REST API documentation.
personal-dashboard-rest-endpoint-summary: Summary of the GET feed endpoint, shown in the REST API documentation.
personal-dashboard-rest-endpoint-desc-fe: Description of the GET feed endpoint, shown in the REST API documentation.
personal-dashboard-rest-param-desc-feed-: Description of the sources query parameter of the feed REST endpoint, shown in the API documentation. The link text is the only translatable part of the Markdown link.
Description of the limit query parameter of the feed REST endpoint, shown in the API documentation.
Description of the continue query parameter of the feed REST endpoint, shown in the API documentation.
personal-dashboard-rest-schema-desc-feed: Description of the items property of the feed REST endpoint's response, shown in the API documentation.
Description of the continue property of the feed REST endpoint's response, shown in the API documentation. continue is a parameter name and is not translated.
Description of the incomplete property of the feed REST endpoint's response, shown in the API documentation. incomplete is a property name and is not translated.
personal-dashboard-rest-property-desc-id: Description of the id property of a feed item, shown in the REST API documentation.
personal-dashboard-rest-property-desc-fe: Description of the feedorigin property of a feed item, shown in the REST API documentation. Its value is a source name such as recentchanges, which is not translated.
personal-dashboard-rest-property-desc-ti: Description of the title property of a feed item, shown in the REST API documentation.
personal-dashboard-rest-property-desc-re: Description of the revid property of a feed item, shown in the REST API documentation.
personal-dashboard-rest-property-desc-pa: Description of the pageid property of a feed item, shown in the REST API documentation.
personal-dashboard-rest-property-desc-ol: Description of the old_revid property of a feed item, shown in the REST API documentation. null is a JSON literal and is not translated.
personal-dashboard-rest-property-desc-us: Description of the user property of a feed item, shown in the REST API documentation.
personal-dashboard-rest-property-desc-ti: Description of the timestamp property of a feed item, shown in the REST API documentation.
personal-dashboard-rest-property-desc-ne: Description of the newlen property of a feed item, shown in the REST API documentation.
personal-dashboard-rest-property-desc-ol: Description of the oldlen property of a feed item, shown in the REST API documentation.
personal-dashboard-rest-property-desc-pa: Description of the parsedcomment property of a feed item, shown in the REST API documentation. The summary is withheld when revision deletion hides it from the viewer.
personal-dashboard-rest-property-desc-de: Description of the description property of a feed item, shown in the REST API documentation. This is the page's short description, from Wikibase or the ShortDescription extension.
personal-dashboard-rest-property-desc-mi: Description of the minor property of a feed item, shown in the REST API documentation.
personal-dashboard-rest-property-desc-bo: Description of the bot property of a feed item, shown in the REST API documentation.
personal-dashboard-rest-property-desc-ne: Description of the new property of a feed item, shown in the REST API documentation.
personal-dashboard-rest-property-desc-ta: Description of the tags property of a feed item, shown in the REST API documentation.
personal-dashboard-rest-property-desc-or: Description of the oresscores property of a feed item, shown in the REST API documentation. Model and class names such as revertrisklanguageagnostic and true are not translated.
personal-dashboard-rest-property-desc-th: Description of the title property of a discussion thread feed item, shown in the REST API documentation.
Description of the pageid property of a discussion thread feed item, shown in the REST API documentation.
Description of the timestamp property of a discussion thread feed item, shown in the REST API documentation.
Description of the section property of a discussion thread feed item, shown in the REST API documentation. A section is the heading a discussion is held under on a talk page.
Description of the anchor property of a discussion thread feed item, shown in the REST API documentation. The anchor is the fragment part of a URL, after the #.

Description of the topic property of a discussion thread feed item, shown in the REST API documentation. A discussion held under a sub-heading names the top-level discussion it belongs to. null is a JSON literal and is not translated.
Description of the commentCount property of a discussion thread feed item, shown in the REST API documentation.
Description of the authorCount property of a discussion thread feed item, shown in the REST API documentation.
Description of the latestReplyId property of a discussion thread feed item, shown in the REST API documentation.
personal-dashboard-rest-feed-bad-continu: Error returned by the feed REST endpoint when the continue token cannot be read, or was made for a different set of feed sources. continue is a parameter name and is not translated.
